sinks._comment: Single-column mode (no 'columns' array): the whole record is serialized into one ClickHouse String column. 'mode':'raw_text' plus explicit 'encoding':'text' renders it as flat 'key=value,key2=value2' text (nested maps as '{k=v;k2=v2}'), no server-side materialized projection. 'target_column' renames that column from the default 'payload' to 'log_line'.
